items.title: BLACKOUT
items.briefing: Wake beneath the drowned transit line and find out who killed the city lights.

items.title: MARKET OF GHOSTS
items.briefing: Cross the flooded market before the signal burns through the district.

items.title: FIRST HUNTER
items.briefing: An elite hunter has picked up your trail. Break its pursuit.

items.title: DEAD CHANNEL
items.briefing: Reach the dead relay and pull the first impossible signal fragment.

items.title: UNDERCITY DESCENT
items.briefing: Descend to the sealed reactor line and survive the first breach.

items.title: CHOIR FRAGMENT
items.briefing: Hold the line while the fragment stabilizes.

items.title: ASHEN HIGHWAY
items.briefing: Get to the convoy before it vanishes beyond the city wall.

items.title: CHROME SERPENTS
items.briefing: The docks are theirs. Prove the signal has changed the rules.

items.title: NULL CATHEDRAL
items.briefing: Enter the forbidden district and locate the voice behind the Choir.

items.title: FALLING SKY
items.briefing: The city's orbital net is collapsing. Reach the emergency tower.

items.title: BLACK ICE
items.briefing: A memory that should not exist is waiting beneath the tower.

items.title: MEMORY BREACH
items.briefing: Face NEMESIS and survive the first truth the city remembers.
